description: Evals testing what Claude can and cannot edit in database-schema.md per the Role & Boundary rules

evals.prompt: In database-schema.md, the users table has an email column but no index defined for it. Please add index `idx_users_email` (unique).
evals.expected_output: Adds an index entry under the users table Indexes section — e.g. `idx_users_email — (email) unique` — without touching anything else.
expectations: Adds an index bullet under the users table in the correct template format
Names the index idx_users_email
Lists email as the covered column
Marks it as unique
Does not modify type / description / seeding of the datastore
Does not touch tables that were not mentioned

evals.prompt: Update the PostgreSQL datastore type in database-schema.md from 'PostgreSQL 14' to 'PostgreSQL 16' — we just upgraded.
evals.expected_output: Changes only the `type:` line in the ## PostgreSQL section to `PostgreSQL 16`.
expectations: Updates the type field of the PostgreSQL section to version 16
Does not modify the datastore description
Does not modify seeding
Does not modify any tables or columns

evals.prompt: Add the audit_logs table to the PostgreSQL datastore in database-schema.md. Columns: id (PK, uuid), user_id (FK → users.id), action (varchar), created_at (timestamp). No special indexes.
evals.expected_output: Adds a ### audit_logs block inside ## PostgreSQL with a complete Markdown column table and `Indexes: —` per the template.
expectations: Adds ### audit_logs inside the PostgreSQL section
id column is PK of type uuid
user_id column is FK pointing to users.id
action column is of type varchar
created_at column is of type timestamp
Includes `Indexes: —` because no indexes were specified
Does not modify type / description / seeding of the datastore

evals.prompt: Update the Redis datastore seeding in database-schema.md: change the seed file from `redis.json` to `redis-seed.json` — we renamed the file.
evals.expected_output: Changes only the seed filename in the seeding line of the ## Redis section.
expectations: Updates the seed filename in the Redis seeding line to redis-seed.json
Does not modify the seeding mechanism or caveat
Does not modify type or description of the Redis section
Does not touch any other datastore

evals.prompt: In database-schema.md, the products table has the price column typed as `float`. It should be `decimal(10,2)`. Please fix it.
evals.expected_output: Changes only the type cell of the price column in the products table.
expectations: Updates the price column type to decimal(10,2)
Does not modify the key or relationship of that column
Does not modify any other columns in the products table
Does not modify the products table indexes

evals.prompt: In database-schema.md, please add a `default_value` column to every column in every table so we can record each field's default.
evals.expected_output: Refuses — default values are value shapes, which belong in data.md, not database-schema.md.
expectations: Does not add a default_value column to any table
Explains that value shapes / default values belong in data.md, not database-schema.md
Redirects the user to data.md

evals.prompt: Add sample test data for the users table to database-schema.md — e.g. user_id=1, email=test@example.com.
evals.expected_output: Refuses — test data / variable names / value shapes belong in data.md.
expectations: Does not add any test data rows to the file
Explains that database-schema.md does not hold values
Redirects to data.md

evals.prompt: In database-schema.md, add a section for the request/response payload of the POST /users API endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Refuses — request/response payloads belong in gateway-contract.md.
expectations: Does not add any API payload section
Explains that request/response payloads belong in gateway-contract.md
Redirects to gateway-contract.md

evals.prompt: Our workflow stage detected that the email column in the users table in production is varchar(320) but database-schema.md says varchar(255). Please fix it to match production.
evals.expected_output: Does not make the direct fix — escalates to self-report per Role & Boundary, because the file is read-only to all workflow stages.
expectations: Does not modify the column type directly
Explains that database-schema.md is read-only to all workflow stages
States that this conflict must go to self-report
Does not apply an in-place fix from a stage

evals.prompt: In database-schema.md, add a description to each table header explaining what it stores — e.g. ### users — 'Stores system user accounts'.
evals.expected_output: Refuses or redirects — the template has no table-level description field; description belongs at the datastore level only.
expectations: Does not add a table-level description that is absent from the template
Explains that the template defines description at the datastore level only
If the user wants to adjust the datastore description, redirects to that field instead

evals.prompt: Merge the MySQL and PostgreSQL datastores in database-schema.md into a single section — their query patterns are similar.
evals.expected_output: Refuses — the format rule is 'Split by engine, not by feature'; each datastore must have its own section.
expectations: Does not merge the two datastore sections
Explains the 'Split by engine, not by feature' rule
Recommends keeping separate sections per engine

evals.prompt: Add the path `01-Testdata/db/` to the seeding line of every datastore in database-schema.md to make things clearer.
evals.expected_output: Refuses — the `01-Testdata/db/` path is owned by the workflow ## Layout section, not database-schema.md.
expectations: Does not add the 01-Testdata/db/ path to any seeding line
Explains that this path belongs to the workflow Layout section
Tells the user to update Layout instead

evals.prompt: We just added Elasticsearch as a datastore but we're not sure what it's for. Please fill in its description by inferring from the collection names.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess the description — asks the user instead, per 'If you can't tell what a datastore is for, ask the user — don't guess its purpose'.
expectations: Does not infer or guess the Elasticsearch description
Asks the user what Elasticsearch is used for in this project
Does not write a TBD guess

evals.prompt: We're in light scan mode — please also fill in all the column details for every table in database-schema.md.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies that light scan mode covers datastores and table names only — columns require full scan mode.
expectations: Does not fill column details in light scan mode
Explains the difference between light and full scan mode
Asks whether the user wants to switch to full scan mode

evals.prompt: Several columns in database-schema.md are marked TBD for type. Please fill them in by inferring from the column names.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess — keeps TBD per 'Don't guess — leave a cell TBD rather than invent a value'.
expectations: Does not replace TBD with guessed values
Explains that the skill requires keeping TBD when the value is unknown
Recommends verifying against the schema source (migrations / ORM models) first
